22
Yordan ho afɔrebukyia no
1Ɛnna Yosua frɛɛ Rubenfoɔ ne Gadfoɔ ne Manase abusuakuo fa no, 2#Num 32.20-22; Deut 3.18-20 na ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Mo deɛ, moadi deɛ AWURADE akoa Mose hyɛɛ mo no nyinaa so, na moatie me nne, deɛ mehyɛɛ mo no nyinaa mu. 3Moannya mo nuanom nna dodoɔ yi de abɛduru nnɛ da yi, na moahwɛ AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn mmara nsɛm no adi so. 4Na afei AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn de mo nuanom atena ase dwoodwoo, sɛdeɛ ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn no; enti monsane na monkɔ mo ntomadan mu, mo agyapadeɛ asase a AWURADE akoa Mose de maa mo Yordan agya no so. 5Na mo ho yie nko na monhwɛ, na monni ahyɛdeɛ ne mmara a AWURADE akoa Mose hyɛɛ mo no so, na monnɔ AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn, na monnante n’akwan nyinaa so, na mommu ne mmara nsɛm, na momfam ne ho na monsom no mo akoma nyinaa ne mo kra nyinaa mu. 6Na Yosua hyiraa wɔn, na ɔgyaa wɔn kwan, na wɔsii mu kɔɔ wɔn ntomadan mu.
7Na Manase abusuakuo fa no, Mose de wɔn deɛ maa wɔn Basan, na ɔfa no nso, Yosua de wɔn deɛ maa wɔn wɔn nuanom mu, Yordan agya atɔeɛ fam. Na Yosua regya wɔn kwan akɔ wɔn ntomadan mu no, ɔhyiraa wɔn, 8#Num 31.27 na ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Momfa nnoɔma bebree nsane nkɔ mo ntomadan mu, mmoa bebree pa ne dwetɛ ne sika ne kɔbere mfrafraeɛ ne dadeɛ ne ntoma pii pa ara, mo ne mo nuanom nkyekyɛ mo atamfoɔ asadeɛ no mu. 9Na Rubenfoɔ ne Gadfoɔ ne Manase abusuakuo fa no firii Israelfoɔ no nkyɛn wɔ Silo a ɛwɔ Kanaan asase soɔ sane wɔn akyiri sɛ wɔrekɔ Gilead asase so, wɔn sodie asase a wɔnam AWURADE ahyɛdeɛ a ɛnam Mose soɔ no so de maa wɔn no.
10Na wɔduruu Yordan ho asase a ɛwɔ Kanaan asase soɔ no soɔ no, Rubenfoɔ ne Gadfoɔ ne Manase abusuakuo fa no sii afɔrebukyia hɔ wɔ Yordan ano, afɔrebukyia a wohwɛ a, ɛso.
11Na Israelfoɔ no tee sɛ wɔse: Hwɛ, Rubenfoɔ ne Gadfoɔ ne Manase abusuakuo fa no asi afɔrebukyia wɔ Kanaan asase no anim, Yordan ho asase no so, ɔfa a ɛyɛ Israelfoɔ deɛ no so. 12Na Israelfoɔ no teeɛ no, wɔboaboaa Israelfoɔ asafo no nyinaa ano, Silo, sɛ wɔretu wɔn so sa.
13 # Num 25.7 Na Israelfoɔ no somaa Ɔsɔfoɔ Eleasa ba Pinehas maa no kɔɔ Rubenfoɔ ne Gadfoɔ ne Manase abusuakuo fa nkyɛn Gilead asase so, 14na wɔde mmapɔmma du kaa ne ho, Israel mmusuakuo no mu biara mu bapɔmma baako; na wɔn mu biara yɛ ne mpanimfie ti, Israel mpempem no mu. 15Na wɔduruu Rubenfoɔ ne Gadfoɔ ne Manase abusuakuo fa no nkyɛn Gilead asase so, na wɔne wɔn kasaa sɛ: 16#Deut 12.13-14; Lew 17.8-9 Sɛ AWURADE asafo no nyinaa seɛ nie: Fom bɛn na mode afom Israel Nyankopɔn yi sɛ nnɛ moadane mo ho afiri AWURADE akyire, na moasi afɔrebukyia afa, na moate AWURADE anim atua nnɛ yi! 17#Num 25 Peor mfomsoɔ a yɛnnya nnwiraa yɛn ho mfirii mu de bɛsi nnɛ yi na ɔhaw baa AWURADE asafo soɔ no nnɔɔso mma yɛn? 18Na mo deɛ, nnɛ moresane afiri AWURADE akyi? Na morete AWURADE anim atua nnɛ yi, ɔkyena ne bo bɛfu Israel asafo no nyinaa. 19Nanso sɛ mo sodie asase no ho agu fi a, ɛnneɛ montwa mmra AWURADE sodie asase a AWURADE tenabea si soɔ no so na mommɛfa asase nni so wɔ yɛn mu; na AWURADE anim atua na monnteɛ, na yɛn anim atua nso monnte, mo afɔrebukyia a mosi kaa AWURADE yɛn Nyankopɔn afɔrebukyia no ho mu. 20#Yos 7 Ɛnyɛ Sera ba Akan na ɔfom ahyiradeɛ no mu, na abufuo baa Israel asafo no nyinaa soɔ? Nso ɛnyɛ ɔno nko na ɔsɛeeɛ, ne mfomsoɔ no mu.
21 # Num 1.16; 10.4 Na Rubenfoɔ ne Gadfoɔ ne Manase abusuakuo fa no gyee so ka kyerɛɛ Israel mpempem mu atitire no sɛ: 22Onyankopɔn, Tweaduampɔn AWURADE, Onyankopɔn, Tweaduampɔn AWURADE, ɔno na ɔnim, na Israel nso nhunu, yɛyɛɛ no atuateɛ mu anaa AWURADE fom mu na yɛyɛeɛ a, nnye yɛn nkwa nnɛ! 23Sɛ yɛsii afɔrebukyia sɛ yɛresane afiri AWURADE akyi anaasɛ yɛrebɔ so ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ anaa aduane afɔdeɛ anaasɛ yɛrebɔ so asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ a, ɛnneɛ AWURADE mmɛbisa. 24Na ɛyɛ suro ne asɛm bi nti na yɛyɛɛ saa, ɛfiri sɛ yɛse: Ɔkyena bi mo mma bɛka akyerɛ yɛn mma sɛ: Ɛdeɛn na mo ne AWURADE Israel Nyankopɔn no wɔ yɛ? 25Na ɛhyeɛ na AWURADE de Yordan yɛɛ no yɛn ne mo Rubenfoɔ ne Gadfoɔ ntam, monni kyɛfa biara wɔ AWURADE mu; na mo mma bɛma yɛn mma agyae AWURADE suro. 26Enti na yɛkaa sɛ: Momma yɛnsi afɔrebukyia mfa, ɛnyɛ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ na ɛnyɛ okum afɔdeɛ nti, 27#Yos 24.27 na mmom sɛ ɛnyɛ yɛn ne mo ne yɛn awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ a wɔbɛba yɛn akyire no ntam adanseɛ sɛ yɛde yɛn hyeɛ afɔdeɛ ne yɛn kum afɔdeɛ ne yɛn asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ bɛsom AWURADE som no n’anim, na ɔkyena bi mo mma anka ankyerɛ yɛn mma sɛ: Monni AWURADE mu kyɛfa bi! 28Na yɛkaa sɛ: Na ɛba sɛ ɔkyena bi wɔka kyerɛ yɛn anaa yɛn awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ saa a, yɛbɛka sɛ: Monhwɛ AWURADE afɔrebukyia no nsɛsoɔ a yɛn agyanom yɛeɛ, ɛnyɛ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ nti, nanso ɛnyɛ okum afɔdeɛ nti, ɛfiri sɛ ɛne yɛn ne mo ntam danseni. 29Yei mpare yɛn sɛ yɛbɛte AWURADE anim atua, na yɛadane yɛn ho nnɛ afiri AWURADE akyi, na yɛasi afɔrebukyia abɔ so ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ, aduane afɔdeɛ ne okum afɔdeɛ aka AWURADE yɛn Nyankopɔn afɔrebukyia a ɛwɔ ne tenabea anim no ho.
30Na Ɔsɔfoɔ Pinehas ne asafo no mmapɔmma ne Israel mpempem atitire a wɔka ne ho no tee nsɛm a Rubenfoɔ ne Gadfoɔ ne Manasefoɔ no kaeɛ no, na ɛsɔɔ wɔn ani. 31Na Ɔsɔfoɔ Eleasa ba Pinehas ka kyerɛɛ Rubenfoɔ ne Gadfoɔ ne Manasefoɔ no sɛ: Ɛnnɛ na yɛahunu sɛ AWURADE wɔ yɛn mu, sɛ moamfa fom yi amfom AWURADE. Afei moayi Israelfoɔ no AWURADE nsam.
32Ɛnna Ɔsɔfoɔ Eleasa ba Pinehas ne mmapɔmma no sane wɔn akyiri firii Rubenfoɔ ne Gadfoɔ no nkyɛn, Gilead asase soɔ, baa Kanaan asase so Israelfoɔ no nkyɛn, na wɔbɛbɔɔ wɔn amanneɛ. 33Na asɛm no sɔɔ Israelfoɔ no ani, na wɔhyiraa Israelfoɔ Nyankopɔn no; na wɔanka bio sɛ wɔretu wɔn so sa akɔsɛe asase a Rubenfoɔ ne Gadfoɔ te soɔ no. 34Na Rubenfoɔ ne Gadfoɔ no too afɔrebukyia no din: Adanseɛ, ɛfiri sɛ wɔse: Ɛyɛ yɛn ntam danseni sɛ AWURADE ne Onyankopɔn.

Ɛnna Yosua frɛɛ Rubenfoɔ ne Gadfoɔ ne Manase abusuakuo fa no, na ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Mo deɛ, moadi deɛ AWURADE akoa Mose hyɛɛ mo no nyinaa so, na moatie me nne, deɛ mehyɛɛ mo no nyinaa mu. Moannya mo nuanom nna dodoɔ yi de abɛduru nnɛ da yi, na moahwɛ AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn mmara nsɛm no adi so. Na afei AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn de mo nuanom atena ase dwoodwoo, sɛdeɛ ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn no; enti monsane na monkɔ mo ntomadan mu, mo agyapadeɛ asase a AWURADE akoa Mose de maa mo Yordan agya no so. Na mo ho yie nko na monhwɛ, na monni ahyɛdeɛ ne mmara a AWURADE akoa Mose hyɛɛ mo no so, na monnɔ AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn, na monnante n’akwan nyinaa so, na mommu ne mmara nsɛm, na momfam ne ho na monsom no mo akoma nyinaa ne mo kra nyinaa mu. Na Yosua hyiraa wɔn, na ɔgyaa wɔn kwan, na wɔsii mu kɔɔ wɔn ntomadan mu.
Na Manase abusuakuo fa no, Mose de wɔn deɛ maa wɔn Basan, na ɔfa no nso, Yosua de wɔn deɛ maa wɔn wɔn nuanom mu, Yordan agya atɔeɛ fam. Na Yosua regya wɔn kwan akɔ wɔn ntomadan mu no, ɔhyiraa wɔn, na ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Momfa nnoɔma bebree nsane nkɔ mo ntomadan mu, mmoa bebree pa ne dwetɛ ne sika ne kɔbere mfrafraeɛ ne dadeɛ ne ntoma pii pa ara, mo ne mo nuanom nkyekyɛ mo atamfoɔ asadeɛ no mu. Na Rubenfoɔ ne Gadfoɔ ne Manase abusuakuo fa no firii Israelfoɔ no nkyɛn wɔ Silo a ɛwɔ Kanaan asase soɔ sane wɔn akyiri sɛ wɔrekɔ Gilead asase so, wɔn sodie asase a wɔnam AWURADE ahyɛdeɛ a ɛnam Mose soɔ no so de maa wɔn no.
Na wɔduruu Yordan ho asase a ɛwɔ Kanaan asase soɔ no soɔ no, Rubenfoɔ ne Gadfoɔ ne Manase abusuakuo fa no sii afɔrebukyia hɔ wɔ Yordan ano, afɔrebukyia a wohwɛ a, ɛso.
Na Israelfoɔ no tee sɛ wɔse: Hwɛ, Rubenfoɔ ne Gadfoɔ ne Manase abusuakuo fa no asi afɔrebukyia wɔ Kanaan asase no anim, Yordan ho asase no so, ɔfa a ɛyɛ Israelfoɔ deɛ no so. Na Israelfoɔ no teeɛ no, wɔboaboaa Israelfoɔ asafo no nyinaa ano, Silo, sɛ wɔretu wɔn so sa.
Na Israelfoɔ no somaa Ɔsɔfoɔ Eleasa ba Pinehas maa no kɔɔ Rubenfoɔ ne Gadfoɔ ne Manase abusuakuo fa nkyɛn Gilead asase so, na wɔde mmapɔmma du kaa ne ho, Israel mmusuakuo no mu biara mu bapɔmma baako; na wɔn mu biara yɛ ne mpanimfie ti, Israel mpempem no mu. Na wɔduruu Rubenfoɔ ne Gadfoɔ ne Manase abusuakuo fa no nkyɛn Gilead asase so, na wɔne wɔn kasaa sɛ: Sɛ AWURADE asafo no nyinaa seɛ nie: Fom bɛn na mode afom Israel Nyankopɔn yi sɛ nnɛ moadane mo ho afiri AWURADE akyire, na moasi afɔrebukyia afa, na moate AWURADE anim atua nnɛ yi! Peor mfomsoɔ a yɛnnya nnwiraa yɛn ho mfirii mu de bɛsi nnɛ yi na ɔhaw baa AWURADE asafo soɔ no nnɔɔso mma yɛn? Na mo deɛ, nnɛ moresane afiri AWURADE akyi? Na morete AWURADE anim atua nnɛ yi, ɔkyena ne bo bɛfu Israel asafo no nyinaa. Nanso sɛ mo sodie asase no ho agu fi a, ɛnneɛ montwa mmra AWURADE sodie asase a AWURADE tenabea si soɔ no so na mommɛfa asase nni so wɔ yɛn mu; na AWURADE anim atua na monnteɛ, na yɛn anim atua nso monnte, mo afɔrebukyia a mosi kaa AWURADE yɛn Nyankopɔn afɔrebukyia no ho mu. Ɛnyɛ Sera ba Akan na ɔfom ahyiradeɛ no mu, na abufuo baa Israel asafo no nyinaa soɔ? Nso ɛnyɛ ɔno nko na ɔsɛeeɛ, ne mfomsoɔ no mu.
Na Rubenfoɔ ne Gadfoɔ ne Manase abusuakuo fa no gyee so ka kyerɛɛ Israel mpempem mu atitire no sɛ: Onyankopɔn, Tweaduampɔn AWURADE, Onyankopɔn, Tweaduampɔn AWURADE, ɔno na ɔnim, na Israel nso nhunu, yɛyɛɛ no atuateɛ mu anaa AWURADE fom mu na yɛyɛeɛ a, nnye yɛn nkwa nnɛ! Sɛ yɛsii afɔrebukyia sɛ yɛresane afiri AWURADE akyi anaasɛ yɛrebɔ so ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ anaa aduane afɔdeɛ anaasɛ yɛrebɔ so asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ a, ɛnneɛ AWURADE mmɛbisa. Na ɛyɛ suro ne asɛm bi nti na yɛyɛɛ saa, ɛfiri sɛ yɛse: Ɔkyena bi mo mma bɛka akyerɛ yɛn mma sɛ: Ɛdeɛn na mo ne AWURADE Israel Nyankopɔn no wɔ yɛ? Na ɛhyeɛ na AWURADE de Yordan yɛɛ no yɛn ne mo Rubenfoɔ ne Gadfoɔ ntam, monni kyɛfa biara wɔ AWURADE mu; na mo mma bɛma yɛn mma agyae AWURADE suro. Enti na yɛkaa sɛ: Momma yɛnsi afɔrebukyia mfa, ɛnyɛ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ na ɛnyɛ okum afɔdeɛ nti, na mmom sɛ ɛnyɛ yɛn ne mo ne yɛn awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ a wɔbɛba yɛn akyire no ntam adanseɛ sɛ yɛde yɛn hyeɛ afɔdeɛ ne yɛn kum afɔdeɛ ne yɛn asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ bɛsom AWURADE som no n’anim, na ɔkyena bi mo mma anka ankyerɛ yɛn mma sɛ: Monni AWURADE mu kyɛfa bi! Na yɛkaa sɛ: Na ɛba sɛ ɔkyena bi wɔka kyerɛ yɛn anaa yɛn awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ saa a, yɛbɛka sɛ: Monhwɛ AWURADE afɔrebukyia no nsɛsoɔ a yɛn agyanom yɛeɛ, ɛnyɛ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ nti, nanso ɛnyɛ okum afɔdeɛ nti, ɛfiri sɛ ɛne yɛn ne mo ntam danseni. Yei mpare yɛn sɛ yɛbɛte AWURADE anim atua, na yɛadane yɛn ho nnɛ afiri AWURADE akyi, na yɛasi afɔrebukyia abɔ so ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ, aduane afɔdeɛ ne okum afɔdeɛ aka AWURADE yɛn Nyankopɔn afɔrebukyia a ɛwɔ ne tenabea anim no ho.
Na Ɔsɔfoɔ Pinehas ne asafo no mmapɔmma ne Israel mpempem atitire a wɔka ne ho no tee nsɛm a Rubenfoɔ ne Gadfoɔ ne Manasefoɔ no kaeɛ no, na ɛsɔɔ wɔn ani. Na Ɔsɔfoɔ Eleasa ba Pinehas ka kyerɛɛ Rubenfoɔ ne Gadfoɔ ne Manasefoɔ no sɛ: Ɛnnɛ na yɛahunu sɛ AWURADE wɔ yɛn mu, sɛ moamfa fom yi amfom AWURADE. Afei moayi Israelfoɔ no AWURADE nsam.
Ɛnna Ɔsɔfoɔ Eleasa ba Pinehas ne mmapɔmma no sane wɔn akyiri firii Rubenfoɔ ne Gadfoɔ no nkyɛn, Gilead asase soɔ, baa Kanaan asase so Israelfoɔ no nkyɛn, na wɔbɛbɔɔ wɔn amanneɛ. Na asɛm no sɔɔ Israelfoɔ no ani, na wɔhyiraa Israelfoɔ Nyankopɔn no; na wɔanka bio sɛ wɔretu wɔn so sa akɔsɛe asase a Rubenfoɔ ne Gadfoɔ te soɔ no. Na Rubenfoɔ ne Gadfoɔ no too afɔrebukyia no din: Adanseɛ, ɛfiri sɛ wɔse: Ɛyɛ yɛn ntam danseni sɛ AWURADE ne Onyankopɔn.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
